marc:datafield.marc:subfield: MEDDIC世界一流的銷售技術 | MEDDIC shi jie yi liu de xiao shou ji shu

The author of this book is Taiwan’s first elite sales executive to rise from a salesperson to Greater China General Manager in a short period of time. He successfully broke the myth that "top salespeople don't make good managers" by training and leading his sales team to consistently exceed targets year after year. Many of the salespeople he mentored have gone on to become managers across various industries. Drawing on over 20 years of hands-on sales and training experience, he explains every step of the MEDDIC sales methodology. No matter where you are in the sales world or what situation you're in, this powerful sales system can help you successfully develop clients and win big deals!
